## History

The Twin Sailors are a pair of imaginary shore friends invented by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) in his creative writing. He included them, alongside figures like [Nora](../character/nora.md) and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), in a fantastical letter he shared with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) detailing adventures like sailing into a moonglade and visiting the sunset.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P1](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0001), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P2](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0002), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P10](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0010), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P14](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0014), +16 more_

## Relationships

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--twin-sailors.md)

The Twin Sailors are imaginary rock friends created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) who live at the shore and come ashore to talk to him. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) invents fantastical adventures involving them, such as sailing into a moonglade, which he shares in an imaginative composition written for his teacher [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

- Friend of — imaginary rock people friends who come ashore to talk to him  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
